item.title: [2020-08-09 Sun 09:37]
item.description: I accidentally slept later into the morning today than I had planned, but I slept better than I had been so I’m not mad about it, and the weather today seems like it will stay fairly cool. My plans for the day are to 1) relax while my shoes1 bounce around in the dryer - write this log - and then I’m going to go out in the garden and pull up a finished little garden-plot of corn.
